name: s81coll_cfifo_crs

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50: the RTL already registers every data pin -- xd on xf and xd2 on xf2 (ot_s81_static_column_ingress pin register), ri/st on cr (rr/sti), every output from a flop (xa/xb/cc/x2 *_r, rd = rr/rsync, rs = rsync); no clock feed-throughs. A flow pin register would add an edge the die calendar does not price.

structural_change: r5 HALF-CYCLE READ over r4 (S-ELEM CFIFO-HOLD 2026-10-16): route s81coll_cfifo_crs-crs2isolated-COMMIT EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (4_1_cts 21.7k hold buffers, WNS -78.4 -> -56.4 stalled); gate replay of the same CTS needed 38,574 hold buffers, 32k on the two full-cycle cross-root hops bank(xf/xf2)->o(cr_s) and o(cr_s)->xa/xb/x2/cc(cr) that carry the 100 ps die-skew hold reserve. Column read register now: bank -> h (negedge cr_s, one-hot select registered a full cycle ahead) -> o (posedge cr); both cross-root hops half-cycle. Zero stream/status/initialization edge change (bench calendars identical), +1118 FF per instance. r5b: epoch Gray observer is a dedicated register (wgr==gray(wc), same edges) so wc->wg1 hold buffers are not blocked by wc's bank-decode max path (r5 gate chunk 1: RSZ stuck 9k it at -14.3 ps on wg1[1]); +8 FF. r4 RESET FRONTIER and r3 CR ROOT SPLIT retained. Fresh exact-source CTS gate and native audit REQUIRED. r6: deterministic 3xHB4+resizable drivers at each of the 8 wg1 D pins; measured r5b chunk-1 plateau -48.174ps through 10940 iterations / 20471 buffers. Same RTL/clock/epoch/cycles; +24 hold cells +32 drivers per instance. No constraint changes. r5c GATED BANK (S-ELEM CFIFO 1815, parallel structural candidate to hr6): each of the 8 bank slots per lane is written through its own ICG (ot_hdc_cg -> ICGx1) enabled at exactly the base write edges (w_rst_n && wc==slot) instead of an enable-recirculation mux. Removes the 8x1101x2 bank Q->mux->D self-loops (8,805 endpoints at +10.7 ps FF hold inside the 30 ps margin, ~20k padding buffers in RSZ's first hold call). Same edges, 0 cycles, -mux per bank bit, +16 ICG per instance. hr6 gray_hold protected stages retained. Bench pass/warm 5 phase pairs identical offsets; 9 mutants FAIL. r5d (S-ELEM CFIFO 1815): sel and h on negedge o_ck (cr) instead of negedge r_ck (cr_s). Routed r5c r5cgb-e89a6bd7e: DRC 0, 0 congested gcells, but TT -24.48 on 9 h(negedge cr_s)->o(posedge cr) endpoints (half-cycle cross-root hop pays 150 ps inter-root reserve; VT swap only to -3.82) and FF -20.05 on 60 o->xa/xb endpoints. r5d makes h->o intra-root (60 ps, +90 ps) and keeps sel->h intra-root; cross-root hops left: bank(xf)->h and rc(cr_s)->sel, both half-cycle. 0 cycles. r5e (S-ELEM CFIFO 2040): r5d route s81coll_cfifo_crs-r5d-4e1e0b1fd EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116, 556 gcells max 4H/8V overflow in the NW band under the N face, where xa/xb/x2/cc pins occupy every M5 track over x 4.5..96 (r5c same pins routed with 0 overflow: marginal). Same RTL/pins; global placement density 0.50 -> 0.40 (util 29%) so the pin-band fanout spreads further. Parallel structural variant r5f spreads the N pins.
